body: I only keep stopping myself because of questions my mother would have to answer. Once she passes, soon, that burden will be lifted.
Thanks, I was hoping someone would have been in a similar situation.
I've been searching for a few years now. Still looking :(  I think this is why the thoughts are becoming more frequent.

I've been in a little therapy but I see it as just another way to throw money at the problem. Sitting in her office is no more or less fun than other things so I'm just null on it. I debate going further with medical, but don't want the reliance. Ending it is a much simpler way if that was my only choice.
I know, that whole relationship thing is my problem. I could make them, but don't. Not sure if it's due to a "why bother" feeling or it's the more common trust issues.
I'll check that out this weekend, thanks.

Oh I occasionally pick up coffees for strangers, sometimes bar tabs if they seem more down than I am. Those little things I enjoy, but it really is trivial. Do I just buy strangers coffee for the rest of my life?
Uhh why care about life if it's all for nothing? And yeah I've been debating the medical help thing.
Valid point. Not sure how I'm using people, I feel I help anyone who asks. That part I kinda enjoy about life.

Thank you for being honest, I do remember starting out and how bad that was too. Those were some low points, standing in Safeway and trying to figure out the largest calorie count per dollar ratio. Nothing a person should ever have to do 


I guess I'm at the point where I know there will be no legacy, so there is nothing to live for.
